facts: Bharat Paints, since 1976, SCO 30, Bhagat Singh Market, Karnal. WhatsApp: 93558 60009.
Brands: Asian Paints, Dulux, Berger, Nerolac, Dr. Fixit, GIO Paints (own brand), Kupsa Wood Coatings.
GIO Fast Drying Paints are used in 200+ rice mills; Bharat Paints also provides painters for rice mills.
Seepage diagnosis service: site visit plus a report of the cause and the fix.
